mechanics.title: Map screen
mechanics.description: Press M, drag to move, scroll wheel to zoom. Includes a waypoint menu, footsteps showing your recent path, an optional vanilla-map look, and export to PNG.

mechanics.title: Server controls
mechanics.description: Servers can enforce a profile and use the effects xaeroworldmap:no_world_map and no_wm_cave_maps to restrict use.

editor_notes: The author recommends optimizing singleplayer worlds after Minecraft updates for faster map generation.
name: Xaero's World Map
summary: A full-screen, self-writing map of the areas you have explored that shows Xaero's Minimap waypoints. Supports multiple maps per server, cave dimensions such as the Nether, and PNG export.
